title: Killa Blueberry Nic Pouches - 13.2mg / pouch
description: Killa Blueberry Nicotine Pouches offer a vibrant blueberry flavour, perfect for those who enjoy a fruity twist in their nicotine experience. Each pouch contains 13.2mg of nicotine, making it a suitable choice for adult users who prefer a steady and satisfying nicotine release. The Blueberry flavour provides a refreshing and fruity taste, delivering a long-lasting and enjoyable experience. These pouches are entirely tobacco-free, offering a clean and convenient alternative to traditional nicotine products. The discreet design of Killa Blueberry pouches makes them ideal for use in various settings, whether you're on the move, at work, or in a social environment where traditional nicotine use isn’t feasible. Killa Nicotine Pouches are crafted with a focus on consistency and quality, ensuring a reliable nicotine experience. Simply place a pouch between your upper lip and gum, and enjoy a steady release of nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With 20 pouches per pack, Killa Blueberry offers a practical and refreshing option for those who enjoy a fruity flavour while relieving nicotine cravings. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a steady nicotine release for up to 30min. 2 Place the used nicotine pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch.
